projects.title: Magic the Gathering: Endless Stack
projects.summary: A Magic the Gathering based roguelite deckbuilder.
projects.details: This a python based game which makes use of the Magic the Gathering rules system inside of a roguelite deckbuilder. In order to best support the multitude of cards that Magic offers it uses an algorithmic AI system to directly convert and card texts to code which can be executed. This is then extended through a simple modding system which is built off of Magic Set Editor to allow for the usage of completely custom cards without any coding or programming.
